receiver_policy.template_key: directed capture domain + transport endpoints including ports + SourceID
receiver_policy.sequences: Only consecutive export packet sequence numbers (uint32 wrap allowed); exact adjacent duplicate reuses its original pre-observation context without lease refresh. Gaps, reordering, conflicting duplicates, uptime or capture-clock regression, explicit malformed carrier/message and prior tuple codec switch quarantine affected templates; a complete fresh self-contained definition recovers.
receiver_policy.reported_flows: Reported flow records/flowId/direction are distinct from captured TCP flows, stream IDs, packet endpoints and native direction.
receiver_policy.scope_zero_width: System scope type 1 may explicitly have length zero; no invented range; ordinary zero-width fields or fully zero-length data records are not accepted.
receiver_policy.padding: Selected 0-3 octets with count-constrained unique record boundaries. Nonzero padding is retained with a SHOULD conformance warning; ambiguous boundaries are refused.

remaining: NetFlow v1/v5/v7/v8 and IPFIX v10 native ingress not added in this phase; v9 over TCP not selected.

All IANA/de-facto enterprise information elements, absolute uptime-derived timestamps and per-bit TCP flag aliases are not certified. Unsupported field semantics retain literal bytes and limited coverage.

61 original initial v9 data records lack an already observed native schema; 25 Scapy records occur after observed sequence gaps. Both differences remain, even though the reference tool uses a known future/stale schema.
Overall original generic field/endpoint/session and unsupported carrier/fuzz differences remain in the report; this is not global acceptance.
